title: ExtractionSchema
description: Schema for structured data extraction for Tri-Chandra Multiple Campus official letter (English header, Nepali body)

ref_no.description: Official reference number (सङ्ख्या/Ref. No.) at the top left. Extract exactly as printed including slashes, dashes, digits.

date.description: Official date (मिति) as printed at upper right in Nepali (Bikram Samvat), exactly as shown.

recipient.description: First recipient line (name and salutation — e.g. श्री ज्योति कुमारी भट्ट जोशी) from the first address block under header.

recipient_department.description: Second line in recipient block: the department/designation under the recipient name — e.g. समाजशास्त्र विभाग.

recipient_campus.description: Third line in recipient block: the campus/organization, e.g. त्रि-चन्द्र बहुमुखी क्याम्पस. Extract exactly, including punctuation if present.

subject.description: The subject line (विषय:- ...), preserving full text after the colon and all punctuation, in Nepali.

body.description: Main letter body text after the subject, up to the lists of बोधार्थ. Preserve paragraphing if present; else, as one block. In Nepali. Do not duplicate any words.

signed_name.description: Printed official's name below the signature placeholder – e.g. प्रा. डा. नीलम श्रेष्ठ प्रधान.

position.description: Printed official designation below the name — typically 'क्याम्पस प्रमुख' or 'Campus Chief'.

signature_placeholder.description: Always '(Signed)' exactly, since signature is handwritten and replaced with a placeholder.

seal_placeholder.description: Always 'Round Office Seal' exactly. Positioned over stamp impression right of header.

logo_placeholder.description: Always 'Tribhuvan University Crest'. Shows where the university's coat of arms/logo appears at the upper left.

qr_placeholder.description: Always 'QR Code'. Placeholder for QR code in the upper right header.

watermark_placeholder.description: Always 'Clock Tower Watermark'. Placed behind body as a faint placeholder at page center.

bodharth_list.description: List of all Nepali बोधार्थ:/CC list/notification recipients, one string per item, as printed in the bottom section with enumeration.

email_address.description: Footer email address as printed at bottom left, e.g. info@trc.tu.edu.np.

website_url.description: Footer website URL as printed at bottom right, e.g. https://trc.tu.edu.np

footer_line.description: Always a single horizontal line from left to right before footer contact. Leave as '---' in JSON to signal layout.

signature_seal_placeholder.description: Always 'Office Stamp/Seal'. Placeholder under signatory position in signature area.
